clues: This small town sits on the island of East Falkland. It rests on a slope that faces north.
Rain falls often in this wet corner of the islands. Few spots in the whole group get as much rain as this slope.
In the year 2022 this place was made a city. The award came as part of the Platinum Jubilee Civic Honours.
Almost every person in these islands lives in this one town. The rest of the islands are home to just a small share.
This town is the capital city of the Falkland Islands. If you named the seat of the islands' government, you found it.
